import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                      c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='RdYlGn_r', 
                      alpha=0.6, s=50, edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress Level)', fontsize=12)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=10)

# Plot 2: Sleep Quality Distribution by Occupation (top 6 occupations)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top_occ = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top_occ, x='Occupation', y='Quality of Sleep', 
            palette='Set2', ax=ax2)
ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality by Occupation\n(Top 6 Occupations)', fontsize=12)
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Plot 3: Physical Activity vs Daily Steps colored by Sleep Disorder
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
colors = {'None': '#2ecc71', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c', 'Insomnia': '#3498db'}
for disorder in df['Sleep Disorder Filled'].unique():
    mask = df['Sleep Disorder Filled'] == disorder
    ax3.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Physical Activity Level'], 
                df.loc[mask, 'Daily Steps'],
                label=disorder, alpha=0.6, s=50, 
                c=colors.get(disorder, '#95a5a6'),
                edgecolors='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps\nby Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
ax3.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', fontsize=9)

# Plot 4: Correlation heatmap of numeric variables
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 
                'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            fmt='.2f', square=True, ax=ax4, 
            cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8},
            annot_kws={'size': 9})
ax4.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=12)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', rotation=0)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
